environment_requirements.notes: Current upstream master explicitly targets Ubuntu 24.04 and ROS 2 Jazzy. ROS 2 Humble remains an environment blocker unless a separately validated port is registered as another implementation.

input_requirements.livox_path: Current master provides slict_livox_to_ouster for Livox ROS driver 2 data; arbitrary PointCloud2 layouts are not assumed compatible.
input_requirements.config: A dataset-specific SLICT YAML must explicitly encode topics, LiDAR-to-body extrinsic and timestamp handling.

benchmark_notes: Research-tier continuous-time surfel optimization baseline. Upstream YAML defines lidar_extr as a transform from LiDAR coordinates into the body frame, so the adapter uses the benchmark LIDAR_TO_IMU body convention. Unsupported environments remain BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT rather than receiving hidden ports.
